### Bio:

My research interests lie at the intersection of machine learning, scalability, and viral epidemic dynamics. I am currently pursuing my PhD under the guidance of Dr. Andrew Holbrook, where I have worked on scalable generative models over graphs and am now focused on phylogenetic applications of graph neural network models. Outside of research, I enjoy staying active, gardening, going to the movies, playing video games, taking long walks on the beach, drinking coffee, and being beholden to my three cats.
